name: Demon Cave
description:
Demon Cave

Value: 2000
Rarity: 30

Size 1: guarded by 3x4 Demons and 2x3 Earth Elementals, gives 2500 gold and 2 mercury (15%)
Size 2: guarded by 3x6 Demons and 2x4 Earth Elementals, gives 4000 gold and 3 mercury (35%)
Size 3: guarded by 3x8 Demons and 2x6 Earth Elementals, gives 5000 gold and 5 mercury (35%)
Size 4: guarded by 3x12 Demons and 2x9 Earth Elementals, gives 7500 gold and 10 mercury. (15%)

Upper-right stack of Demons and lower-left stack of Earth Elementals have 50% chance to be upgraded.
